The recordings library opens quickly again, however many recordings you have.

With a large library, opening the library, switching back to Parley, or typing in the search box could freeze the app for a moment, and the pause grew with every recording you added. With cloud sync on, a library of a thousand recordings stalled for about half a second each time, and a few thousand for several seconds.

- **Checking which recordings are synced no longer slows down as the library grows.** It used to re-read the whole sync record once for every recording. It now reads it once per listing.
- **Listing recordings no longer freezes the other windows.** Voice typing and settings stay responsive while the library loads.
- **Long lists show the first recordings straight away.** Rows are added in batches as you scroll, instead of all being built before anything appears. The count at the top still shows the total.
